newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed as spread narrows.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed as spread narrows.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled mixed and the December/March spread narrowed, echoing a trend in the other two U.S. wheat markets, traders said.

U.S. wheat values were undermined early as it became clear that Egypt's most recent purchase of U.S. wheat did not include any soft red winter, althought support in spring wheat came from scale-down commercial buying, traders said.

MGE spring wheat closed 1-3/4 cents per bushel lower to 1/4 cent higher, with Dec down 1-3/4 cents at $4.05. The May contract posted a new low of $3.38-1/2. The Dec/March spread traded as low as 12-1/2 cents, after closing at around 15-1/4 cents Friday.
Benson-Quinn, CIS, Continental and LFG each bought at least 500,000 Dec, traders said, while Atwood/Peavey sold one million Dec.
MGE barley futures settled 10 to 15 cents per cwt lower, with Dec down 10 cents at $6.60.
